description: This file implements MDIO (Management Data Input/Output) access routines for Broadcom B53 Ethernet switch chips within the Linux kernel. It provides functions for reading and writing various sizes of data over the MDIO bus, handles switch register paging, and registers PHY driver structures for specific B53 chip variants. It also includes driver initialization and cleanup routines.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_op(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 op)
methods.description: Performs a read or write operation on a specific page and register of the switch via MDIO, handling page switching and operation completion checks.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * val)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from the specified switch register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from the specified switch register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from the specified switch register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 48-bit value from the specified switch register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value from the specified switch register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 value)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to the specified switch register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to the specified switch register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 value)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to the specified switch register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 48-bit value to the specified switch register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value to the specified switch register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_phy_read16(struct b53_device * dev,int addr,u8 reg,u16 * value)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit PHY register at a given address.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_phy_write16(struct b53_device * dev,int addr,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a PHY register at a given address.

methods.name: int b53_phy_probe(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Probe function for initializing B53 switch PHY driver, setting support capabilities, and registering the switch.

methods.name: int b53_phy_config_init(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Initial configuration for the B53 PHY during device setup.

methods.name: void b53_phy_remove(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Cleanup function for the B53 PHY driver, called upon removal.

methods.name: int b53_phy_config_aneg(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Configure auto-negotiation; placeholder returning success.

methods.name: int b53_phy_read_status(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Read and update link status, speed, duplex, and link state for B53 PHY.

methods.name: int __init b53_phy_driver_register(void)
methods.description: Register the B53 PHY driver structures for different chip variants.

methods.name: void __exit b53_phy_driver_unregister(void)
methods.description: Unregister the B53 PHY driver structures.
